title: Super Pow
description: Given a positive integer `a` and a very large positive integer `b` represented as an array of decimal digits (most significant digit first, with no leading zeros), compute `a^b mod 1337`.
constraints: b does not contain leading zeros and represents a positive integer.
hints: Use the exponent identity `a^(10 * q + d) = (a^q)^10 * a^d (mod 1337)` to process `b` one decimal digit at a time from left to right.
Reduce `a` modulo `1337` upfront and evaluate each small power (`^10` and `^d`) with modular binary exponentiation.
